overviews.jaffle_shop:
## Data Documentation for Jaffle Shop

`jaffle_shop` is a fictional ecommerce store.

This [dbt](https://www.getdbt.com/) project is for testing out code.

The source code can be found [here](https://github.com/dbt-labs/jaffle_shop_duckdb).

nodes.name: jaffle_shop_daily
nodes.description: Daily jaffle_shop run: load seeds, build the dbt models, test them, then refresh reporting.

nodes.name: customer_dashboard
nodes.description: Weekly view of customers, their orders and lifetime value.

nodes.name: customers
nodes.description: This table has basic information about a customer, as well as some derived facts based on a customer's orders

nodes.name: customer_id
nodes.description: This is a unique identifier for a customer

nodes.name: first_name
nodes.description: Customer's first name. PII.

nodes.name: first_order
nodes.description: Date (UTC) of a customer's first order

nodes.name: last_name
nodes.description: Customer's last name. PII.

nodes.name: most_recent_order
nodes.description: Date (UTC) of a customer's most recent order

nodes.name: number_of_orders
nodes.description: Count of the number of orders a customer has placed

nodes.name: total_order_amount
nodes.description: Total value (AUD) of a customer's orders

nodes.name: orders
nodes.description: This table has basic information about orders, as well as some derived facts based on payments

nodes.name: amount
nodes.description: Total amount (AUD) of the order

nodes.name: bank_transfer_amount
nodes.description: Amount of the order (AUD) paid for by bank transfer

attrs.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN jaffle_shop.main.stg_payments.payment_method = 'bank_transfer' THEN jaffle_shop.main.stg_payments.amount ELSE 0 END)

nodes.name: coupon_amount
nodes.description: Amount of the order (AUD) paid for by coupon

attrs.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN jaffle_shop.main.stg_payments.payment_method = 'coupon' THEN jaffle_shop.main.stg_payments.amount ELSE 0 END)

nodes.name: credit_card_amount
nodes.description: Amount of the order (AUD) paid for by credit card

attrs.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN jaffle_shop.main.stg_payments.payment_method = 'credit_card' THEN jaffle_shop.main.stg_payments.amount ELSE 0 END)

nodes.name: customer_id
nodes.description: Foreign key to the customers table

nodes.name: gift_card_amount
nodes.description: Amount of the order (AUD) paid for by gift card

attrs.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN jaffle_shop.main.stg_payments.payment_method = 'gift_card' THEN jaffle_shop.main.stg_payments.amount ELSE 0 END)

nodes.name: order_date
nodes.description: Date (UTC) that the order was placed

nodes.name: order_id
nodes.description: This is a unique identifier for an order

nodes.name: status
nodes.description:
Orders can be one of the following statuses:

| status         | description                                                                                                            |
|----------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| placed         | The order has been placed but has not yet left the warehouse                                                           |
| shipped        | The order has ben shipped to the customer and is currently in transit                                                  |
| completed      | The order has been received by the customer                                                                            |
| return_pending | The customer has indicated that they would like to return the order, but it has not yet been received at the warehouse |
| returned       | The order has been returned by the customer and received at the warehouse                                              |

nodes.name: notify_crm
nodes.description: Tell the CRM that lifetime values have been refreshed.

nodes.name: Completed order
nodes.description: An order the customer has received and not returned.

nodes.name: Customer
nodes.description: A person with an account, whether or not they have ordered.

nodes.name: Customer lifetime value
nodes.description: Total value of every payment a customer has made, across all orders and payment methods, in Australian dollars.

attrs.exceptions: Refunds are not netted off; returned orders still count.

nodes.name: Order amount
nodes.description: Total of all payments recorded against an order, in Australian dollars.

nodes.name: Payment method
nodes.description: How a payment was made, as recorded by the payment provider.
